## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` are clean
- [ ] `cargo test` passes, including the conformance tests
- [ ] `plugin.json` lists every permission the plugin needs and nothing more
- [ ] No compiled component is committed
- [ ] Works in the graphical editor, the terminal editor and batch mode, or the README says what does not and why
- [ ] `CODEOWNERS` has a line for this plugin
